page.overview:
What is Antoumek?

Antoumek was a small town located along the shores of the Lake of Mists in the Hordelands in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Antoumek sat along the southern shore of the Lake of Mists in between Almorel to the east and Strelsi to the west. It was located approximately north of the Golden Way.
